changes_since_r44: Tool Abstraction Layer: app/research_tool.py -- a provider-independent research/search tool interface mirroring app/llm_client.py's design. market_verification.py's Anthropic-specific web_search mechanics (tools parameter, pause_turn continuation, last-text-block extraction) relocated unchanged into an AnthropicWebSearchTool adapter; market_verification.py now only builds prompts and parses responses, never touching Anthropic mechanics directly. Verified no direct Anthropic tool invocation remains outside the adapter.

Fresh Decision Intelligence -- first vertical slice (app/pipeline/fresh_intelligence.py): a free, deterministic gate firing only for the target case shape (real category subject + real supplier spend + a real requested change, i.e. the 'Industrial Valves / Supplier A / 11%' vertical), one gated research call, and a buyer-facing composition (WHAT CHANGED / WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU / WHAT IS PROVEN / WHAT IS NOT PROVEN / MY VIEW / NEXT MOVE / WHAT COULD CHANGE THIS) or a fixed, honest 'no current external development identified' message when nothing relevant is found. Adds exactly one new value ('external_research') to the existing MarketDriverClaim.attributed_to field -- zero new evidence-chain logic; confirmed by direct test that externally-researched claims flow through market_intelligence.py's already-proven reasoning chain untouched, including never being auto-attributed to the case's supplier.
Minimal frontend rendering for the Fresh Intelligence answer, appended to the existing market-verification panel.
capabilities_included: Commercial Intelligence Kernel -- single evidence/truth layer shared by every reasoning profile
Supplier Request, Commercial Signal, Category Strategy, Complex Problem Solving -- all four rendered as genuinely distinct buyer experiences with adaptive depth within each
Dependency-aware category roadmap with real prerequisite chains and decision gates
Unknown -> Investigation conversion for material market/ESG evidence gaps
Complex Problem Solving vertical slice with the Maersk principle enforced structurally
Provider-independent LLM client abstraction across all five model-calling files
Provider-independent research/search tool abstraction, with the Anthropic web-search adapter as the only registered provider
Fresh Decision Intelligence -- first vertical slice, proactive but narrowly gated live research for a specific case shape
Safe buyer-facing transport -- diagnostics excluded from the default API response
Adaptive answer composition proven dynamic-not-random across all tested experiences
Four-tile front door with preserved free-text classification
known_limitations: Fresh Decision Intelligence's frontend rendering is minimal -- appended plainly to the market-verification panel, not yet matching the polish of the four main experience renderers.

The Fresh Intelligence gate is narrow by design (price_increase cases with real spend+percent data only) and has not been tested against edge cases like partial evidence or multiple suppliers in the same case.

The live web-search path (both market_verification.py's claim verification and fresh_intelligence.py's proactive research) remains unproven against the real Anthropic API -- no live key exists anywhere in this build or the environment that produced it.

market_verification.py's and fresh_intelligence.py's shared reliance on Anthropic's server-side web_search tool remains a genuine, documented exception to full provider independence for the search mechanism itself (the client/model layer is fully abstracted).
The four-experience audit this round was a quick confirmatory review, not an exhaustive re-verification -- that rigor was spent in prior rounds this session.
No live Claude/Anthropic API access exists anywhere in this build. Every test, including all HTTP-path and fresh-intelligence tests, is deterministic and mock-based.

configuration_requirements.database: PostgreSQL 16, schema at db/schema.sql -- additive/idempotent migrations only, safe against any prior database in this lineage.

migration_requirements: Run db/schema.sql. No new migrations in this release beyond what R42 already introduced.
packaging_notes: No secrets, real API keys, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, or local caches included. .env.example/.env.test.example contain only placeholder values, confirmed by direct inspection before packaging. Working tree unchanged between the final regression run (656 passed) and this ZIP's creation -- no application code was modified after that run.
